# Royal collectibles and the secret ending

- Original source: [Royal collectibles and the secret ending](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=792309796)
- Author / publication: xXDylanXWithinXx / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; published 2016-11-02; updated 2022-06-01
- Access: Full guide page retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: none found in the Wayback Machine (checked 2026-09-09)
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes (no redistribution grant on Steam guides, so not transcribed)

The guide maps royal objects to missions:

| Mission | Royal object |
| --- | --- |
| The Prince and the Outlaw | Sceptre |
| The Evening Visitor | Domesday Book |
| The Lock-up and the Friar | Coronation Spoon |
| The Silver Arrow | Sword of State |
| A Wedding and a Funeral | Ampulla |
| The Escape | Royal seal |
| The Letter | Crown |

Some pickups require dialogue progression, a particular guard's defeat, or beggar information. Consult the original for locations.

**Terminology caution:** its numbering includes the Silver Arrow alongside royal regalia. The scoring guide treats them differently. Ending-condition code was not verified.

## Detailed notes

Guide metadata at retrieval: posted 2 Nov 2016 2:02pm, updated 1 Jun 2022 3:11pm; 33 ratings; categories Secrets, Story or Lore, Walkthroughs; 2,121 unique visitors, 43 favourites, 11 comments; signed "El Huevo". A Russian translation by another user was published in October 2025 (Steam file id 3589535751) with the author's permission. Each item section is illustrated with screenshots hosted on images.steamusercontent.com; the steps for the Ampulla are given only as an image, so they are not captured here.

**Introduction.** Royal items are optional secondary objectives in some castle levels; collecting them unlocks a secret ending. Levels with collectables: The Prince and the Outlaw, The Evening Visitor, The Lock-up and the Friar, The Silver Arrow, A Wedding and a Funeral, The Escape, The Letter.

**Item locations as described.**
1. "Royal rod" (sceptre), The Prince and the Outlaw, Derby castle: after Robin and Marian discover Prince John's betrayal in the meeting room, a previously inaccessible room to the right of the castle opens; the rod is next to the guards there.
2. Domesday Book ("Doomsday book"), The Evening Visitor, Ranulph's castle in Leicester: unlocked after the main objective of telling Ranulph about the betrayal; Ranulph mentions it; guarded by the sheriff's soldiers, who may be killed; in the south-east tower, the same tower where Will Scarlet was imprisoned.
3. Coronation spoon, The Lock-up and the Friar: dropped by the red knight at the top of the Derby tower above the meeting room; only obtainable after defeating him.
4. Silver Arrow, The Silver Arrow, Nottingham: the tournament prize was bait and is never awarded, but it lies in the castle next to the jail cell, protected by two spearmen and a red knight.
5. Sword of State, same mission: in Nottingham's church, heavily guarded by soldiers and knights. Both items are available from the start of the mission in any order.
6. Ampulla ("crystal phial"), A Wedding and a Funeral, south York: a black officer talks to a woman outside her house; her jealous husband keeps interrupting, and the pair hide inside until he leaves. The required steps are shown in a screenshot; the author warns to be quick because she leaves right after the husband is gone or knocked down; then take down the officer and pick up the phial.
7. Royal seal, The Escape, Nottingham: after freeing Robin, sneak into the king's room and fight a single red knight.
8. Royal crown, The Letter: a beggar above the contact Allan, if paid enough, sends you to York's church, where a stack of money and the crown are found; described as one of the last items needed for the secret ending and 100% completion.

**Comment thread.** Mostly thanks (2021–2025); the author notes some items are very easy to miss.

Robin Hood: How to get the secret ending

By xXDylanXWithinXx

In addition to the main story of Robin Hood, there are collectables that you can find through the game that add a little more challenge to the game. These collectables unlock a secret ending. In this guide I will teach you where and how to get them.

Introduction 

During your playthrough in some of the castle levels there are some collectable royal items that you can collect, these are secondary objectives that you can get and are not necessary to complete the game. However, they are fun to collect since it adds more replayability to the game and allows Robin to dab on Prince John.  
  
These collectables are in the following levels:  


  * The prince and the outlaw  

  * The evening visitor  

  * The lock-up and the friar  

  * The silver arrow  

  * A wedding and a funeral  

  * The escape  

  * The letter



First Item: The royal rod 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285567562/A98A730F0BD822B6F7D7C48C7DEA28C750A28029/)  
  
This item can be found in the level “ _The prince and the outlaw_ ” in the castle of Derby, after Robin and Marian find out Juan’s betrayal in the reunion room, an inaccessible room located to the right of the castle will become accesible, next to the guards you can find **the royal rod**.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285617154/8644F1364293558F5319D8909110CA0CA53401C2/)[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285569080/FB3053F8F8654BA045AD462A8441ECD578C8585D/)

Second item: The Doomsday book 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285724772/7E736C73047B4AEB7C8C6C272205D24D8706A0EE/)  
  
The second item is **the Doomesday book** , this can be found in the mission “ _The evening visitors_ ” on Ranalfa Leicester’s castle. This unlocks after completing the main objective of talking to Ranulph about prince Juan’s betrayal. This book is mentioned by Ranulph and is guarded by the sheriff's soldiers, which can be killed. The book is located to the south-east of the castle, the same tower where Will Scarlet was imprisoned.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285725539/B70010D3CA4E329968DCE905A4704896DA8A7CFC/)

Third item: The coronation spoon 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285930804/060E221897EF39D851D54E0A570828D81FCE203A/)  
  
The third item is located in the level “ _The lock-up and the friar_ ” at the top of the tower of Derby you can get this item. However it can be obtained after defeating the red knight at the top of the tower, located on top of the reunion room of the castle of Derby. Only after the knight is down **the royal coronation spoon** will be dropped.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568285927520/C7B32DDACAAAABDDC872CE1D1CB53B58802D49F1/)

Fourth and fifth item: The silver arrow and the state sword 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286158244/1E3A7C5780D18F831C215D4B0FAA084A360922C0/)  
  
In the level “ _The silver arrow_ ” in the castle of Nottingham you can find two items, the first one is the silver arrow and the second one is the sword of state.  
  
The Silver arrow is the price for the archer tournament. However it is not given to you as a prize, since it was only bait used to set Robin a trap, but this item can be acquired. It is located in the castle, next to the jail sail of said castle, it is protected by two spearmen and a red knight.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286159330/E83F63E5C908947C2A80817E0A8A6A304CF16758/)  
  
The state sword is located in the church of Nottingham, it is heavily protected by guards and knights, so beware.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286166778/25D363E73E13239AE57E08DDC0E0077D1DACF662/)  
  
_**These items are available right away from the start of the game, and there is no order or requirements to get these items.**_  


Sixth item: The Ampulla 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286189394/D5AF7C250D126745D1B2829BF7B6D72281105FFD/)  
  
In the level "_A wedding and a funeral_ " you can find the sixth item. This item requires a few extra steps, in the south of York there is a black Guvnor who talks to a lady outside her house, the problem is that her husband is very jealous of him and does not allow them to talk, so when the husband gets close the guvnor and the lady run back to their home and hide until the husband leaves again.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286173588/21807F75649A34F2E84246361095475A5912F602/)  
  
So, _**follow these steps**_ :  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286174992/711AC233CB5DC5E61BDB10CA098B0D50A6916F4B/)  
  
also, be quick since she leaves immediately after the husband is gone or knocked down. After that, take down the guvnor and take **the crystal phial**. 

Seventh item: The royal seal. 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286232439/004D8790115E73846C01AB8E69EB38EA64943D88/)  
  
The seventh item can be found in the level “ _The escape_ ” in Nottingham. After rescuing Robin from jail you can sneak into the King’s room and fight a single red knight to get **the royal seal**.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286230333/99E045341EF771E2693F0B425950FAEB6F8F3567/)

The last item: The royal crown 

[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286274559/43E92B9CA2F9DB8D7C7B0303D334FB2D9FF68BC5/)  
  
In the mission “ _The letter_ ” at the top of where your contact**Allan** is, there is a _**beggar**_ , which if you give him enough money will send you to the church of York, there you find two secrets, a stack of money and **the royal crown** , one of the last items you require to unlock the secret ending and to finish the game 100%.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286276801/7D503CEB1E1B19AE166DB055D606CED30C4A4A2B/)  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286277533/D28230740CE996BBD8C6EA58D936AD319B3ED99D/)  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286278350/DEEF0A7C850379D0F3B2CA4BB1A83274C9FCCDED/)

Thanks for reading this guide. 

Hope this guide was helpful to you and it was worth the effort.  
  
[](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1654475568286304454/5F95086C181AD7C6C5D24162C7CD1505590EDCEB/)  
  
kind regards,  
El Huevo.
